header: Found 9 declarations mentioning riemannZeta and deriv.

hits.doc:
The L-series of the von Mangoldt function `Λ` equals the negative logarithmic derivative
of the Riemann zeta function on its domain of convergence `re s > 1`.
hits.name: ArithmeticFunction.LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq_deriv_riemannZeta_div
hits.type: {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeries (fun n => ↑(ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n)) s = -deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s

hits.name: log_deriv_riemannZeta_add_inv_sub_bounded
hits.type: : (fun s => deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s + (s - 1)⁻¹) =O[nhdsWithin 1 {1}ᶜ] fun x => 1

hits.name: deriv_riemannZeta_add_inv_sub_sq_bounded
hits.type: : (fun s => deriv riemannZeta s + (s - 1)⁻¹ ^ 2) =O[nhdsWithin 1 {1}ᶜ] fun x => 1

hits.name: deriv_riemannZeta_eq_neg_inv_sub_sq_add
hits.type: {s : ℂ} (hs : s ≠ 1) : deriv riemannZeta s = -(s - 1)⁻¹ ^ 2 + deriv riemannZeta₀ s

hits.name: log_deriv_riemannZeta_add_inv_sub_sub_isLittleO

hits.type: {s : ℂ} (hs : s ≠ 1) : deriv riemannZeta s = -(s - 1)⁻¹ ^ 2 * riemannZeta₁ s + (s - 1)⁻¹ * deriv riemannZeta₁ s
